## Wave 5 Summary

Two DR3-readiness / observational-surface gates carried forward verbatim from S102 Wave 5. **Item 15** (`S103-BRANCH-IV-DEEP-TRUNCATION`) re-evaluates the spectral-triple-direct branch-iv `w₀(L)` evaluator at deeper truncation L∈{12,13,14} to test whether the CAC spread converges below the 0.05 band that the S102 W5-2 run FAILed at (spread = 0.130419 > 0.05); because the irrep-construction wall lives at p+q ≥ 13, the gate is feasibility-gated and its INFO branch is the Friedrich-Bär envelope substitution for the L≥13 tail. **Item 16** (`S103-Q28-LAYER2-A6`) runs the A₅ → A₆ sixth-regulator atlas-cardinality robustness sub-test on the S67 √x functional selection — the single untested conjunct of the n_s COMMIT/WITHDRAW adjudication that S102 W5-6 left HELD as `COMMIT-pending-Q28-Layer-2`. The COMMIT/WITHDRAW map is **FIXED by the S102 W5-6 spec** (PASS ⇒ COMMIT ⇒ mack mints the committed standalone n_s falsifier row at 0.9590 / 1.4048σ; FAIL ⇒ WITHDRAW; INFO ⇒ robustness still untested); this gate block cites that map, it does NOT re-derive it.

Source for both: the S102 W5 WP `## Carry-Forward Computations` block (`sessions/session-102/session-102-w5-workingpaper.md` §"CF-S103-W5-2-BRANCH-IV-DEEP-TRUNCATION" + §"CF-S103-Q28-LAYER2-ATLAS-CARDINALITY-A6").

```yaml

gate_id: "S103-BRANCH-IV-DEEP-TRUNCATION"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY]"                          # threshold (spread < 0.05) + a [SIGN] directional sub-claim on the spread trend; 3-tuple companion row REQUIRED
classification: "GEOMETRIC"                   # ρ_B(L) is a truncation-indexed spectral functional of D_K (Zubarev a_4-channel moment); the fabric itself, not its excitations

The branch-iv spectral-triple-direct ρ_B(L) extraction + Friedrich-Bär feasibility argument is gen-physicist/spectral-geometry domain; mack-cosmic-bridge owns the DR3-readiness interpretation only.

method:
  description: >
    Re-evaluate ρ_B(L) = ρ_Zubarev(L) (the spectral-triple-direct branch-iv
    evaluator established in S102 W5-2) at L_max ∈ {12, 13, 14}, forming the
    CAC prediction w₀^CAC(L) = ρ_B(L) + offset_B with the DERIVED, zero-free
    offset_B = −0.265281419488 (= w₀_B − ρ_B(L=10); no fit targets w₀_B).
    Compute the CAC spread = max_L w₀^CAC(L) − min_L w₀^CAC(L) over the extended
    L-set (offset cancels ⇒ spread = max_L ρ_B(L) − min_L ρ_B(L)). The L=12
    value reuses the S102 W5-2 npz (−0.634885419265). L=13 and L=14 require
    new spectra. BECAUSE the irrep-construction wall lives at p+q ≥ 13 (recursive
    Casimir-projection super-polynomial; empirically infeasible within an agent
    timeslot per `math-scripts.md §"D_K Block-Diagonality + Recursive-Casimir-
    Projection Feasibility Pre-Check"`), run the MANDATORY feasibility pre-check
    FIRST: (a) attempt direct L=13/14 block diagonalization sector-by-sector via
    the s84 L12 cache + recursive irrep construction, OR (b) if infeasible,
    establish the L^{-α} tail bound via the Friedrich-Bär structural-saturation
    theorem (η_FB(p,q) floor on the L12 master cache ⇒ NEW-sector eigenvalue
    lower bound ⇒ ρ_B-tail envelope). The INFO branch IS exactly substitution (b).
    CAC convention is MANDATORY (regulator-convention-lockdown.md): w₀^CAC(L) =
    ρ_B(L) + offset_anchored-at-L10; the rho-direct convention (RDC) is FORBIDDEN.
  producing_script: "computations/session-103/s103_branch_iv_deep_truncation.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "span"
  form: "spread_CAC = max_{L in {12,13,14}} w0_CAC(L) - min_{L in {12,13,14}} w0_CAC(L) ; PASS iff spread_CAC < 0.05"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "0.05"                              # the W5-2 DR3-readiness band, UNCHANGED per item-15 spec ("PASS band < 0.05 unchanged from W5-2")
  direction: "<"

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "3"                                 # L_max ∈ {12, 13, 14}
  L_max: "{12, 13, 14}"                       # extended truncation set; L=12 reuses W5-2 npz, L=13/14 NEW (feasibility-gated)
  scan_range: "L in [12, 14]"

  tolerance: "1e-12"                          # offset-cancellation residual + reproduction-identity rel_tol (Sage cross-check RealField 200, per W5-2)
  scheme: "zeta"                              # ρ_B = ρ_Zubarev spectral-triple-direct evaluator (the canonical branch-iv scheme; W5-2 4-tuple scheme=zeta)
  convention: "CAC-branch-iv-anchored-L10-DERIVED-OFFSET"  # canonical-anchored convention per regulator-convention-lockdown.md; RDC FORBIDDEN
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "torch.linalg"                    # block-diagonal sector eigvalsh on D_K Peter-Weyl blocks (largest L=14 block dim well under VRAM; per math-scripts.md feasibility note dense storage fits AMD RX 9070 XT 17.1GB with margin)
  regulator_pin: "a_4^{Mellin}"              # branch-iv R-slot consumes the a_4-channel Mellin-cone residue (W5-2 companion row regulator_pin=a_4^{Mellin}; regulator-pin-discipline.md MANDATORY)
  # CLASS: not applicable — the branch-iv evaluator (ρ_Zubarev spectral-triple-direct) does NOT consume a SCHEMATIC helper (s102 W5-2 cross-check #2 validated ρ_B against the S86 canonical offset_Zubarev=−0.340827; FULL physical, not SCHEMATIC). No CLASS pin required.
  publication_precision: "6"                  # spread published to 6 sig figs (W5-2 reported 0.130419); downstream DR3-readiness consumers use rel_tol >= 1e-6

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap", "s102_branch_iv_npz", "s84_L12_cache"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "Extending the truncation window from {8,10,12} to {12,13,14} can lower
    the CAC spread below 0.05 (PASS) ONLY IF the ρ_B(L) trajectory decelerates
    (flattens) at L≥12; if the per-unit-L decrement persists, the spread GROWS and
    PASS is unreachable — in which case the Friedrich-Bär envelope (INFO) is the
    admissible bound."
    Step 1 (ρ_B definition, W5-2 npz, full float64):
        ρ_B(L=8)  = −0.504465997912
        ρ_B(L=10) = −0.577172580512
        ρ_B(L=12) = −0.634885419265
        [source: s102_branch_iv_canonical_eval.npz; ρ_B = ρ_Zubarev spectral-triple-direct]
    Step 2 (CAC anchor identity, regulator-convention-lockdown.md):
        offset_B := w₀_B − ρ_B(L=10) = −0.842454 − (−0.577172580512) = −0.265281419488   [DERIVED; zero free normalization]
        w₀^CAC(L) := ρ_B(L) + offset_B
        ⇒ spread_CAC = max_L w₀^CAC(L) − min_L w₀^CAC(L) = max_L ρ_B(L) − min_L ρ_B(L)   [offset cancels exactly]
    Step 3 (current decrement, from {10,12}):
        Δρ/ΔL |_{10→12} = (ρ_B(12) − ρ_B(10))/2 = (−0.634885419265 − (−0.577172580512))/2 = −0.028856419377 per unit L
        ⇒ sign(Δρ/ΔL) = NEGATIVE (ρ_B strictly DECREASING in L)
    Step 4 (extended-window spread if decrement persists; linear extrapolation, diagnostic only):
        ρ_B(13) ≈ ρ_B(12) + (−0.028856) = −0.663742 ;  ρ_B(14) ≈ ρ_B(12) + 2·(−0.028856) = −0.692598
        spread_{12,13,14}^linear = ρ_B(12) − ρ_B(14) ≈ −0.634885 − (−0.692598) = 0.057713
        Direction: 0.057713 > 0.05 ⇒ if the decrement PERSISTS, PASS is NOT reached (spread exceeds band).
    Step 5 (deceleration is the PASS pathway):
        PASS (spread_CAC < 0.05 over {12,13,14}) requires |ρ_B(14) − ρ_B(12)| < 0.05, i.e. the AVERAGE
        decrement over {12→14} must fall below 0.025/unit (vs the current 0.028856/unit) — a flattening
        toward a truncation asymptote. The gate's COMPUTED ρ_B(13),ρ_B(14) (or the Friedrich-Bär bound)
        decide whether the trajectory decelerates enough.
    Conclusion: The spread direction is set by the (monotone-decreasing) ρ_B(L) trend; PASS is reachable
    ONLY through deceleration of the decrement at L≥12. The linear-persistence extrapolation (0.0577 > 0.05)
    is a DIAGNOSTIC pre-flight (NOT the verdict — the gate computes the actual L=13/14 values or bounds them
    via Friedrich-Bär). The [SIGN] sub-claim is "ρ_B(L) decreasing ⇒ spread non-decreasing absent deceleration";
    sign_verdict = PASS iff the computed decrement-sign matches NEGATIVE.

# (8) input_files
input_files:

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  CAC spread over L∈{12,13,14} < 0.05 (strict). The spectral-triple-direct
  branch-iv evaluator is truncation-converged at deeper L ⇒ DR3-readiness YES;
  the w0_FW_R842 = −0.842454 promotion becomes substrate-truncation-defensible
  (the promotion still fires only on the DR3 data-release per the R_842 binary
  rule — this gate establishes the EVALUATOR'S readiness, not the data verdict).
  Track A in the dual prior.
FAIL_meaning: >
  CAC spread over L∈{12,13,14} ≥ 0.05 (the decrement persists / the trajectory
  does not flatten enough), with direct L=13/14 spectra computed. The branch-iv
  evaluator reproduces w₀_B exactly at L=10 but is NOT truncation-stable ⇒
  DR3-readiness NO; w0_FW_R842 promotion correctly stays withheld. Track B. This
  is a constraint-map update (a corridor of DR3-readiness closed at deeper L),
  NOT a script error — the evaluator remains internally consistent (real, finite).
INFO_meaning: >
  Direct L≥13 spectra are infeasible at the p+q≥13 irrep-construction wall, AND
  the Friedrich-Bär L^{-α} structural-saturation envelope bounds the ρ_B tail
  WITHOUT direct diagonalization. The registry state is DR3-readiness-PENDING-
  FRIEDRICH-BAR-ENVELOPE: if the FB bound itself falls < 0.05 the tail is
  envelope-bounded-PASS (note in INFO_meaning, NOT a top-line PASS without direct
  spectra); if it only brackets the tail above 0.05, Track B is retained. INFO is
  the pre-registered feasibility-substitution outcome (NOT an incomplete result).

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/session-103/s103_branch_iv_deep_truncation.py"
    - "computations/session-103/s103_branch_iv_deep_truncation.npz"
    - "computations/session-103/s103_branch_iv_deep_truncation.png"
  estimated_time: "1 gate (feasibility-gated: ~2-3 h if Friedrich-Bär envelope substitutes; up to ~4 h if direct L=13/14 sector diagonalization is attempted before the wall is hit)"

substrate_framing: |
  GEOMETRIC. ρ_B(L) IS a truncation-indexed spectral functional of the Dirac
  operator D_K on Jensen-deformed SU(3) — the Zubarev a_4-channel moment of the
  fabric itself, evaluated at successive L_max truncations. The branch-iv pathway
  IS the substrate's transit through the van-Hove fold (tau_fold=0.190); w₀_B IS
  the late-time equation-of-state image of that transit through the CAC anchor
  identity, NOT a dark-energy field IN a ΛCDM container. Direction of explanation:
  D_K eigenvalues → Zubarev a_4-channel spectral moment ρ_B(L) → CAC anchor
  w₀^CAC(L) = ρ_B(L) + offset_B → emergent late-time w₀ → DESI DR3 comparison.
  The L^{-α} convergence question IS a substrate-IS truncation-stability question
  (does the finite-L spectral triple's a_4-moment stabilize?), not a fitting
  question — the offset is DERIVED (zero free normalization), so the spread is a
  pure structural diagnostic of the finite-L spectral triple. The Friedrich-Bär
  envelope is the substrate's own structural-saturation theorem (the NEW-sector
  eigenvalue lower bound from the η_FB floor), so the INFO branch remains a
  substrate-first statement, never an external-paper placeholder.
```

```yaml
    Step 3 (robustness conjunct = THIS gate's output): robustness := (√x survives A_5→A_6 with criteria unchanged).

        robustness == FAILS   ⇒ WITHDRAW fires ⇒ n_s removed from the falsifier surface; Q28 reopening documented.
        robustness == UNTESTED-at-A_6 (e.g. A_6 evaluation underdetermined) ⇒ INFO (robustness still untested).

        σ = |0.9590 − 0.9649| / 0.0042 = 0.0059 / 0.0042 = 1.404761... ≈ 1.4048σ   [rounds to 1.40σ]
        Direction: the σ-distance does NOT enter Step 1–3; it is the (value, scheme) consequence of the COMMIT branch only.
        (value,scheme) disclosure: the constant-ε gauge-invariant canonical n_s_framework=0.9561 is a DIFFERENT scheme
        at a DIFFERENT σ (|0.9561−0.9649|/0.0042 = 2.0952σ); the COMMIT pins WHICH functional (√x), and √x fixes 0.9590.

    (the Row #85 HELD discharge). The 1.4048σ is reported, never used to decide. NO data-agreement appeal enters

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  The √x functional selection survives the A₅→A₆ sixth-regulator atlas-cardinality
  extension with its pre-registered S67 extremality/selection criteria UNCHANGED
  (√x remains the unique pass-all survivor; the n_s>1 anomaly-exclusion holds under
  A₆). robustness == ROBUST ⇒ COMMIT fires: the Q28 Layer-2 robustness conjunct is
  DISCHARGED, atlas-08 Q28 is answered (the n_s prediction is functional-selection-
  robust, NOT scheme-dependent), and mack-cosmic-bridge mints the committed standalone
  n_s falsifier row (the Row #85 HELD discharge) at 0.9590 / 1.4048σ per the
  pre-registered commit_row_preregistration block. Track A.
FAIL_meaning: >
  The √x selection does NOT survive A₆ (a sixth regulator re-admits a competitor as
  a pass-all survivor, OR the n_s>1 structural exclusion breaks under A₆). robustness
  == FAILS ⇒ WITHDRAW fires: n_s is REMOVED from the falsifier surface, Row #85 is
  retired-with-reason, and atlas-08 Q28 reopening is documented (the selection is
  atlas-cardinality-dependent). This closes the "n_s is functional-selection-robust"
  corridor — a constraint-map update, NOT a script error. Track B.
INFO_meaning: >
  The A₆ evaluation is underdetermined (e.g. the sixth-regulator selection criterion
  cannot be evaluated cleanly under the augmented atlas, or the survivor set is
  ambiguous at the Layer-2 pole-compressing spread). robustness == UNTESTED-at-A₆ ⇒
  the decision STAYS at COMMIT-pending: Row #85 remains HELD, the committed-row mint
  stays reserved, and the discharge re-queues (A₇ / alternative sixth-regulator).
  INFO is the pre-registered "robustness still untested" outcome (NOT an incomplete
  result) — the S102 W5-6 INFO branch carried one session forward.
```
